title: Biome Localizations
description: Adds localization text to biomes missing them in various mods.
body:
__**Biome Localizations**__

Biome Localizations currently adds 109 localizations to biomes missing them from various mods. This means they will now show up properly rendered in mods such as Nature's Compass or a minimap mod displaying the current biome.

For instance, `biome.terralith.windswept_spires` (unlocalized) will properly render as _Windswept Spires_.

![With and Without](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87c191cd88d101dc2ec37c7365fe94839cd9f1ff_0.webp)

__**Adds biome localization for the following mods:**__

*   Ars Elemental
*   Blood Magic
*   Hexerei
*   Terrablender
*   Terralith

__**Mod Development**__

Biome Localizations is still in development. More localizations will be added in the future. You can suggest which mods to add localization to in our Discord server.

[ReversTeam Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/TJKZgr6UDg)

 

Feel free to be used in any modpack.
